decisions.reason: Box car trailers are a core line, and the firm keeps them through ongoing model updates rather than withdrawing them.
Low-bed trailers are a staple product with steady demand from private and professional users, so continuing them fits the firm's focus.
High covers are a low-cost accessory that complements the box trailer range and supports sales of the base models.
This second box trailer series may overlap with B and could be consolidated, but several price segments are common in this market, so keeping it is more likely.
